processes.name: Lac Operon Regulation
processes.description: The lac operon is a classic example of prokaryotic gene regulation (Jacob & Monod, Nobel Prize 1965). Maximum complexity flowchart with 63 nodes, 5 OR gates (orange), 2 AND gates (lavender), showing environmental sensing, transport, regulatory logic gates, transcription control, and metabolic pathways.

processes.name: DNA Replication Initiation at oriC
processes.description: DNA replication initiation in E. coli occurs at oriC through DnaA protein regulation. Contains 1 OR logic gate (DnaA-ATP availability check).

processes.name: Transcription Initiation and Regulation
processes.description: Transcription initiation by RNA polymerase holoenzyme with sigma factor regulation. Contains 2 OR logic gates (sigma factor availability, regulatory factor type).

processes.name: Cell Cycle Control and CDK Regulation
processes.description: Eukaryotic cell cycle control via CDK-cyclin regulation with checkpoints. Contains 1 AND gate (Start checkpoint) and 2 OR gates (DNA replication, spindle assembly checkpoints).
